source_refs.note: 3. Relative Speed: a main subheading of 10.8 Factors affecting emf, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 243-243.

blocks.text: The speed of the coil (or conductor) through a magnetic field also affects the magnitude of the induced emf. Faster speed increases the rate of change of magnetic flux that results into an increase in the induced emf.
